question: Does the user's peak-cascade construction (per-epoch C_t pre-image + finite-diff omega + multi-epoch consistency) recover truth (q, omega) on seed 89?
hypothesis: At each LC peak (q, omega) is constrained, so cascading the per-epoch pre-image filters across peaks isolates truth.
narrative_md: Per-epoch C_t pre-image filtering works (truth-q within 0.53-2.14 deg at each of 3 epochs), but Tier-1 joint (q, omega) consistency fails on seed 89: 6 triples accepted, none near truth (nearest 25 deg in q, 450% in omega). Diagnosed as a low-|omega| structural failure -- per-dt rotation (1.7 deg) ~ discrete-q sample resolution (1.5 deg) so finite-diff omega accumulates O(100%) noise. Predicted to work at higher |omega| (revisited in s049). Reads truth-q nearest checks; v2 surrogate (s048b retests on v1).
